physiciansAct.article25NormalizedText: 醫師有下列情事之一者，由醫師公會或主管機關移付懲戒：一、業務上重大或重複發生過失行為。二、利用業務機會之犯罪行為，經判刑確定。三、非屬醫療必要之過度用藥或治療行為。四、執行業務違背醫學倫理。五、前四款及第二十八條之四各款以外之業務上不正當行為。
physiciansAct.engineeringObservation: Article 25 enumerates physician disciplinary-referral grounds. The named owner/legal disposition treats it as risk context and approves the exact site notice architecture recorded here; this collector makes no independent legal conclusion.
physiciansAct.htmlResponseFingerprintNote: The official MOJ HTML contains dynamic counters and is intentionally not byte/hash-bound; the normalized Article 25 text above is the machine-bound authority excerpt.

presentationBoundary.statement: The 30 governed JSON inputs are byte-frozen; Astro component and route shells are presentation code and are not described as immutable.

reviewFixtures.statement: Review fixtures are fictional/non-governed and are never counted as approved clinical inputs.

definitions.exactNormalizedText: 職業運動傷害影片圖鑑以公開比賽影片的觀察為基礎，整理職業運動常見傷害的 教學案例。本站是教學資源，不是醫療建議；任何傷害的診斷與處置都需要具 資格的臨床專業人員評估。
definitions.note: Longer About-page medical-purpose statement; final treatment requires named review.

definitions.exactNormalizedText: 雙層筆記設計每個案例同時提供「一般讀者筆記」與「專業筆記」，兩層永遠同時顯示： 一般層描述發生了什麼、畫面看得到什麼、畫面不能證明什麼與已確認的後續 更新；專業層整理機轉分析、臨床限制、鑑別脈絡與治療回場意涵，且每個 專業主張都必須綁定教學文獻證據。

extractionContract.consumptionPointCriterion: Family-specific criterion recorded on every logical occurrence and viewport observation; CSS visibility in a footer is not treated as clinical consumption-point visibility.

extractionContract.landmarkRule: Only native/explicit ARIA landmark roles are reported as landmark; article/figure and unnamed section are separately reported as nearestSemanticContainer.

extractionContract.semanticDomSnapshot: Each route/viewport JSON stores exact matched outerHTML, text/hash, normalized internal links, DOM path, true landmark, nearest semantic container, ancestor-aware visibility, bounding box, viewport intersection, and ancestor/viewport clipping state.
extractionContract.serverBinding: 127.0.0.1 with an OS-assigned ephemeral port; the origin is normalized out of evidence links and is not an evidence invariant.
extractionContract.sourceBinding: The caller must name the exact clean Phase 4 HEAD. A complete Git-tracked SHA-256/byte-length ledger is recorded and remeasured after capture; the dist byte ledger is likewise measured before and after.
